caption_L2L3: Belarus's budget balance has seen a large variation over 5 years, reducing from -0.03 in 2015 to just under -0.01 in 2017, before swinging up to a little under 0.02 in 2018 and then reducing again to slightly over 0.005 in 2019.  Belarus's budget balance is expected to drop drastically in 2020 to near -0.05.  It is then expected to improve gradually over the years until 2025, but is not expected to reach 0.
